newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo central bank to keep discount rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Yugo central bank to keep discount rate unchanged.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) plans to keep its key discount rate for January unchanged at 4.5 percent per month, a central bank official said on Monday.
If confirmed at the NBY Board of Governors meeting, it will be the eighth consecutive month that the discount rate remains unchanged at an annual 68.15 percent.

"It was agreed early this morning that the discount rate will stay at its current level and normally nothing can change the agreement, but you never know," said a central bank source who asked not to be named.

The discount rate was first cut to 4.5 percent last June from 6.31 percent in May in an attempt to influence commercial lending rates down, but the reduction in lending rates failed to materialise. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
